howItWorks.title: How does Hat Akhrak work?
howItWorks.desc: This isn't ordinary shopping — the more people join the same deal, the lower the price gets for everyone who joined, automatically, with no manual steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Browse open deals and join a buying cycle by paying a small deposit — the rest is settled later based on the final price.
howItWorks.step2Desc: The more buyers join the cycle, the lower the price drops to the next tier — and pricing is retroactive, so it applies to everyone who joined from day one.
howItWorks.step3Desc: When the cycle's 72-hour window ends or it hits max buyers, the final price is locked in based on the highest tier the cycle reached.
howItWorks.step4Title: Pay the balance and receive it
howItWorks.step4Desc: Pay the remaining balance online at delivery (no cash on delivery), then you have 48 hours to inspect the item and confirm it's in good shape.
howItWorks.tiersDesc: Everyone in the same cycle pays the same final price, even buyers who joined on day one.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.desc: Everything you need to know about group buying on Hat Akhrak
faq.a1: You join a deal with other buyers, and as more people join, the price drops to the next tier. When the cycle closes, everyone pays the final price the deal reached.
faq.a2: If you cancel with enough time before the cycle closes, your deposit is refunded. Cancelling in the last 24 hours of the cycle isn't available — this is made clear before you pay.
faq.a3: Once the cycle closes and you pay the remaining balance, the merchant starts preparing and shipping orders; timing varies by product and merchant.
faq.q4: Why does the price change between tiers?
faq.a4: A deal starts at a slightly higher price, and once enough buyers join to reach a tier, the price drops for everyone — rewarding participation and sharing.
faq.q5: Can I become a merchant and sell on the platform?
faq.a5: Yes — sign up as a new merchant from the "Sell with us" page, and our team will review your application before your account is activated.
faq.q6: Are merchants on the platform verified?
faq.a6: Merchants with a "Verified merchant" badge have been reviewed by our team; newer merchants may still be pending review.
faq.q7: How do I contact support if there's an issue?
faq.a7: You can open a dispute from the My Orders page if there's a problem with delivery or the product, and our team will review it.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.section1Body: By using the Hat Akhrak platform, you agree to these terms and conditions in full. If you don't agree with any part of them, please don't use the platform.
terms.section2Body: Hat Akhrak is an intermediary platform that groups buyers together to buy wholesale at a lower price from verified merchants; the platform is not the direct seller of the products.
terms.section3Body: You're responsible for the accuracy of your information when registering and for keeping your login details confidential; any activity from your account is your responsibility.
terms.section4Body: When you join a deal, you pay a deposit that secures your place in the cycle; the remaining balance is determined once the cycle closes, based on the last price tier reached.
terms.section5Body: You may cancel your participation and get your deposit refunded up until 24 hours before the cycle closes; after that, joining is considered final and non-cancellable.
terms.section6Body: Merchants registered on the platform are responsible for product quality and agreed delivery timelines; any dispute is handled by the Hat Akhrak team per the dispute-resolution policy.
terms.section7Body: We may update these terms and conditions from time to time, and we'll announce any material change on the platform before it takes effect.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Body: We collect basic information such as your name, phone number and email when you register, along with order and payment data as you use the platform.
privacy.section2Body: We use your data to connect you with merchants, process your orders and payments, and send you important notifications about order and deal status.
privacy.section3Body: We only share the delivery details needed for your order with the merchant; your full financial data is never made available to them.
privacy.section4Body: We use technical safeguards to protect your data from unauthorized access, including encryption of payment data.
privacy.section5Body: You can request to review, correct or delete your personal data at any time by contacting our support team.
privacy.section6Body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time, and we'll announce any significant change before it takes effect.
